notes.title: Version 1.1.0 is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Edited the uncensored version of the "Ashley x Polly" photo to show Polly's junk, which properly reflects her junk setting on the save file.
[*] Edited the uncensored version of the "Lillian x Zoey" photo to show Zoey's tits, because we realized she doesn't show them anywhere else.
[*] Made a couple of small corrections to the "Kyu x Lola" tutorial CG.
[*] Removed bracelets from a couple of Ashley's outfits because they were clipping through certain hairstyles.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the *creamy* version of the CGs to remain visible by default if you switched your save file's gender setting from male to female.
[*] Corrected an exploit that allowed players to buy difficulty exclusive hygiene date gifts and still be able to use them even after downgrading their save file's difficultly.
[*] Made it so that Zoey will never randomly ask about the girl that she is currently with because we thought that was a little weird.
[*] Added an Alpha Mode toggle setting to each save file's reconfiguration menu (which you can access by clicking the girl head icon associated with your save file on the "continue" title screen menu). This replaces the old awkward method of toggling Alpha Mode across all save files with the "BETA 4 EVA" code. The code method will no longer work.
[/list]

[i]If you purchased the game somewhere other than Steam you may have to go back to that store, download the new version of the game and manually replace the old version on your computer. Some stores may need a day or two to finish uploading the updated version of the game to their servers as it is something they have to do manually.[/i]

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Steam achievements have been added to HuniePop 2: Double Date! Just grab the latest update (v1.0.5) and you'll have access to a mix of 20 total progress and challenge achievements to unlock. If you haven't restated Steam in a while, you may want to do that so your Steam client will refresh and recognize that the achievements have been added to the system.

The achievements that can be retroactively unlocked, will be. This means that the game will check your existing save files and automatically award you with achievements that you have technically already earned.

[b]Note:[/b] You can NOT earn achievements on Chad/Stacy (Easy) difficulty. Achievements can only be unlocked within save files that are set to Average Guy/Girl or higher difficulty.

[list]
[*] [b]Unchaste:[/b] Earn your first pair of fairy wings.
[*] [b]Unchaste With Haste:[/b] Earn your first pair of fairy wings within one in-game day.

[*] [b]Debauchery Without Delay:[/b] Collect enough fairy wings to summon the Nymphojinn within 15 in-game days.
[*] [b]Savior:[/b] Return the Nymphojinn to a satisfied slumber.
[*] [b]Super Savior:[/b] Return the Nymphojinn to a satisfied slumber on Incel/Femcel (Hard) difficulty.
[*] [b]Hikikomori:[/b] Earn a 100% completion rate.
[*] [b]Hyper Hikikomori:[/b] Earn a 100% completion rate on Incel/Femcel (Hard) difficulty.
[*] [b]Alpha Apprentice:[/b] Successfully complete 8 Alpha Mode dates.
[*] [b]Alpha Adept:[/b] Successfully complete 24 Alpha Mode dates.
[*] [b]Non-Stop Novice:[/b] Successfully complete a Non-Stop date of 8 or more rounds.
[*] [b]Non-Stop Ninja:[/b] Successfully complete a Non-Stop date of 16 or more rounds.
[*] [b]Quickie:[/b] Successfully complete a date with at least 20 moves remaining.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] I have added keyboard shortcuts that players can use to change the screen resolution at any time. Pressing "Ctrl+DownArrow" will make the screen resolution smaller and "Ctrl+UpArrow" will make it bigger. I am hoping that this will help some of the players who are having screen resolution issues. I have tested this on a 4:3 monitor that was cutting off part of the game window and using the shortcut keys to make the resolution smaller worked like a charm. I realize it's not a perfect solution but I hope it will suffice for now.
[*] More than a few players have reported that smoothies, unique gifts and/or shoes stopped showing up in the store under the impression that it must be a bug. This actually isn't a bug, but I completely understand the confusion. The availability of these gifts is influenced by how much baggage the player has learned about. If a player notices that these items are not showing up, it just means they need to talk to the girls more and learn about more baggage. This wasn't really explained so I added a special notice at the end of Kyu's baggage explanation scene that makes the relationship between baggage and the store much more clear.
[/list]

[*] Fixed a bug that was allowing players to unlock post-game "expanded wardrobe" outfits by completing alpha mode dates.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]Major Performance Improvements:[/b] I've made some serious optimizations which has resulted in a greatly smaller file size, a significant reduction in memory usage, and a much faster start up time. I hope this will help some of the players who are having trouble starting the game. If you are still having trouble getting the game started after this update, I would refer you to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/930210/discussions/0/3103512736623687015/]this troubleshooting thread[/url].
[*] Some players with uncommon screen sizes/resolutions have reported display issues, such as part of the game window being cut off. I changed some of the Unity build settings that will hopefully offer more support for a larger range of screens. If you are still experiencing resolution issues after this update, let me know in the comments and I will continue to investigate what I can do from my end.
[*] Fixed a bug where Nora's "Abandonment Issues" baggage (and possibly other types of baggage) would carry over to the bonus round if you used a hygiene date gift on her during the date.
[*] Fixed a bug where matching the bonus round version of the passion token would still display a "%" in front to the word "Pleasure".
[/list]

[b]POTENTIAL SPOILERS START[/b]

[list]
[*] Players can now unlock hairstyles & outfits that they haven't unlocked yet in Non-Stop Mode.
[/list]

[b]POTENTIAL SPOILERS END[/b]

[b]Note:[/b] Some bug reports are not universal and seem to only apply to a very small handful of players with a specific hardware configuration. These problems are much harder to diagnose and will take some time to get to the bottom of. I may even try to reach out to you and ask for your help if you are one of these players. As always, I appreciate the patience and support!

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] You can now reconfigure a save file by changing the gender, difficulty and polly's junk settings. Just click the save file icon on the "Continue" screen. (Note: You can only DECREASE the difficulty, you can't increase it.)
[*] "Stamina Freeze" has been removed. Stamina freeze would "freeze" a girl's current stamina in place until the next time you saw her if you left her without going on a date first. This was implemented to prevent players from being able to level up their stats without going on dates. Upon review, it seems a little oppressive and we figure if that's how people want to play, more power to them. (Note: If some of your girls already have their current stamina "frozen" from version 1.0.0, it will still apply next time you visit them, but then it will stop.)
[*] For the same reasons listed above, we removed a check from the store population algorithm that would limit the amount of stamina regeneration food items based on the activity of the previous day. From now on there will always be 4 stamina regeneration food items in the store every morning.
[*] Fixed bug where new baggage icons weren't instantly showing up on the lower UI as soon as you learned them on "Chad/Stacy" (Easy) difficulty.
[*] You are now able to organize date gifts on the HunieBee's "Gifts" app just after you finish a date, before you pick the next location to go to. You can use this to carry over date gifts that you really like to your next date.
[*] Decreased the drop rate of Broken Heart tokens by 25% and increased the Stamina token drop rate by the same amount on "Chad/Stacy" (Easy) difficulty.
[*] New date gift added! "Cotton Pillows (Candle)": Increases the amount of Stamina tokens that fall by 25% for the remainder of the date.
[*] New date gift added! "White Lily (Flowers)": Consumes as many Stamina tokens on the grid as the recipient needs to refill her Stamina.
[*] Changed the "Bunny Plush" date gift to convert Broken Heart tokens into Stamina tokens instead of just removing them.
[*] Added a small chance to generate a POWER token from a 3-of-a-kind match. This chance increases with style level as well.
[/list]

[b]POTENTIAL SPOILERS START[/b]

[list]
[*] The special ending "hole selection" Kyu CG is now available on all difficulties, including "Chad/Stacy" (Easy). If you have already completed the game on "Chad/Stacy" (Easy) difficulty, you can still claim your Kyu CG. All you have to do is successfully complete a repeat date with the Nymphojinn and you'll be presented with the ending cutscene again where you'll have the opportunity to select your CG.
[*] You can now disable Alpha mode with a simple code. Just type "BETA 4 EVA" into the code section of the title screen and it will disable Alpha mode across all save files. You can re-enable it whenever you want by typing the same exact code into the code section again. We may implement a cleaner / more formal way to toggle Alpha mode in the future, but the code will work for now.
[*] I tried to push this update last night and a few players quickly alerted me that it introduced a new bug where you would win the final Nymphojinn date no matter what, even if you lost. So, I temporarily rolled back to the previous version, but that has been properly fixed now. That bug was my bad and I apologize if you happen to have encountered it in that brief window while it was live.
[/list]

[b]POTENTIAL SPOILERS END[/b]

Let me know what you think about these changes! There's a lot more that we're planning to do in the near future. This update was mainly focused on balance/playability. The next update will most likely be more focused on bugs/technical stuff. Thanks!
